metadata.title: Nationwide Counterfeit Prescription & Illicit Pharmaceutical Correlation
metadata.forensic_standard: DOJ / DEA NFLIS / FDA OCI / DSCSA 2026 Audit Standard
metadata.lead_investigator: Relator Anthony Michael DiMarcello III / OSINTNeoAi Intelligence Core
metadata.jurisdiction: United States (Federal Interstate & Transnational Border Corridors)

executive_summary.dea_lethality_ratio: 70% (7 in 10 fake prescription pills contain >= 2mg lethal fentanyl dose)
primary_counterfeit_targets: Alprazolam 2mg (Xanax bars pressed with Bromazolam / Flualprazolam)
GLP-1 Agonists (Counterfeit Ozempic/Semaglutide & Mounjaro/Tirzepatide pre-filled pens containing Insulin)
primary_foreign_cartel_manufacturers: Sinaloa Cartel (Guzmán-Salazar / Zambada illicit manufacturing syndicates)
Cártel de Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG industrial rotary press operations)
Precursor Chemical Import Syndicates (Wuhan / Shijiazhuang export brokers)

sample_recalls.product_description: Levothyroxine and Liothyronine (Thyroid Tablets, USP), 1 grain (60 mg), 100-count bottles, Rx Only, Manufactured for: Westminster Pharmaceuticals, LLC, 154 Downing Street, Unit 1 & 2, Olive Branch, MS 38654, NDC 69367-156-04.

counterfeit_categories.illicit_counterfeit_composition: Illicit Fentanyl (1.8mg - 5.5mg), 4-ANPP, microcrystalline cellulose, blue dye
counterfeit_categories.manufacturing_source: Clandestine Mexican industrial TDP-5 rotary pill presses
counterfeit_categories.primary_corridors: I-5 (San Diego -> Orange County -> LA -> Seattle), I-10 (Phoenix -> Houston -> Atlanta)

counterfeit_categories.authentic_imprint: XANAX on obverse, 2 with multi-scores on reverse; white rectangular bar
counterfeit_categories.illicit_counterfeit_composition: Bromazolam, Flualprazolam, Clonazolam, Etizolam, cornstarch binding
counterfeit_categories.manufacturing_source: Domestic clandestine lab presses & international darknet mail drops
counterfeit_categories.primary_corridors: USPS Express Mail Interdiction Hubs (JFK, ORD, LAX, SFO, MIA)

counterfeit_categories.authentic_imprint: Prefilled Novo Nordisk red/blue dial-a-dose pen injector with serial QR code

counterfeit_categories.manufacturing_source: Unlicensed overseas compounders & illegal Turkish/Chinese transshipment
counterfeit_categories.primary_corridors: Illicit online medspas, social media influencers, rogue international telehealth sites

counterfeit_categories.illicit_counterfeit_composition: Synthetic Nitazenes (Isotonitazene, Metonitazene, Protonitazene) 10x-40x potency of fentanyl
counterfeit_categories.manufacturing_source: Underground chemical synthesis labs targeting naloxone-resistant tolerances
counterfeit_categories.primary_corridors: Appalachian & Midwest industrial corridors (Ohio, West Virginia, Pennsylvania)

nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.name: Pacific Coast Interstate-5 Vector
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.origin_points: Tijuana / Otay Mesa / San Ysidro Ports of Entry
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.transit_nodes: San Diego -> Orange County (Irvine/Santa Ana) -> Los Angeles -> Central Valley (Bakersfield/Fresno) -> Sacramento -> Portland -> Seattle
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.interdiction_strategy: CHP / OCSD Highway Interdiction & DEA Special Operations Division (SOD)

nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.name: Transcontinental Interstate-10 Southern Vector
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.origin_points: Nogales / El Paso / Laredo Border Crossings
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.transit_nodes: Phoenix -> Tucson -> Las Cruces -> San Antonio -> Houston -> New Orleans -> Mobile -> Atlanta
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.primary_contraband: Bulk pill shipments in hidden vehicle compartments, hydraulic traps
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.interdiction_strategy: EPIC (El Paso Intelligence Center) & HIDTA Task Forces

nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.name: Midwest & Industrial Rust Belt Vector
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.origin_points: Chicago Distribution Hub / Dallas-Fort Worth Freight Rail
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.transit_nodes: Chicago -> Indianapolis -> Detroit -> Columbus -> Cleveland -> Pittsburgh
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.primary_contraband: Nitazene-pressed counterfeits, Bromazolam bars, M-30 pills
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.interdiction_strategy: DEA Chicago Field Division / Great Lakes Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Forces (OCDETF)

nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.name: Darknet & International Air Cargo Mail Vector
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.transit_nodes: JFK (New York) -> ORD (Chicago) -> LAX (Los Angeles) -> MIA (Miami) -> Nationwide Postal Delivery
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.primary_contraband: Counterfeit Ozempic/Semaglutide pens, Darknet Bromazolam/Xanax batches, Pill press die sets
nationwide_interstate_trafficking_corrid.interdiction_strategy: USPS Postal Inspection Service (USPIS) & CBP Advanced Targeting System

legal_and_statutory_framework.title: Manufacturing & Distribution of Controlled Substances
legal_and_statutory_framework.criminal_exposure: 20 Years to Life Imprisonment; mandatory minimums for 40g+ fentanyl mixture

legal_and_statutory_framework.title: Drug Supply Chain Security Act & Counterfeit Drug Trafficking
legal_and_statutory_framework.criminal_exposure: Strict liability and felony penalties for introducing counterfeit/adulterated prescription drugs into interstate commerce

legal_and_statutory_framework.title: Trafficking in Counterfeit Goods (Pharmaceutical Marks)
legal_and_statutory_framework.criminal_exposure: Up to 20 Years Imprisonment & $5,000,000 individual fines for counterfeit pharmaceutical marks

legal_and_statutory_framework.title: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act
legal_and_statutory_framework.criminal_exposure: Treble civil damages & 20-year criminal sentences for enterprise distribution conspiracies
